notes.title: Digital Pre-orders Now Open!
notes.content:
Starting today, digital pre-orders are available!
In addition to the standard edition, there is the Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes a set of costumes for Rias, Slade, and their friends, plus a Head Start Item Pack to help you progress smoothly through the early stages of the game.
Even more content awaits in the Ultimate Edition—featuring summer-themed costumes and additional playable characters, Resna and Valeria, from Atelier Resleriana!
Pre-order a digital edition by Thursday, September 25 to receive exclusive bonus costumes for Rias and Slade. Don’t miss out!

[h3][b]■ Story Trailer[/b][/h3]
Discover the mysteries of the game in the newly released Story Trailer!
[previewyoutube=5TG17rqeZzI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]■Pre-order Bonus[/b][/h3]
Pre-order the digital edition by Thursday, September 25 to receive exclusive bonus costumes for Rias & Slade!
・"Rough Time Costume Set" for Rias and Slade
　"Light Style" Costume for Rias
　"Carefree Moment" Costume for Slade

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/40b168e8307e3491aff6d8904408d283dcc680a4.jpg[/img]
*This will also be included with the Digital Deluxe or Ultimate Edition listed below if pre-ordered by September 25.

[h3][b]■Digital Deluxe[/b][/h3]
Discover what’s included in the Digital Deluxe Edition!
・Main Game
・Costume Set
　"Starry Navy", "Matching the Fairies" Costume for Rias
　"Fair Sky Blue", "Indomitable Guardian" Costume for Slade	
　"Fighting Spirit", "Silver Ice Swordsman" Costume for Raze
　"Sweets Magic", "Medical Flower" Costume for Wilbell
　"Noble Friend", "Tropical Ocean" Costume for Totori
　"Monochrome Attire", "Mysterious Dream Shard" Costume for Sophie
・Head Start Item Pack
　A set of 10 materials with helpful early-game traits (10 types)
　Equipment: Crimson Virid Pearl
　Equipment: Azure Abyss Pearl

[h3][b]■Ultimate Edition[/b][/h3]
Discover what’s included in the Ultimate Edition!
・Digital Deluxe contents (Main Game, Costume Set, Head Start Item Pack)
・Gust Extra BGM Pack
・Additional Characters - Resna and Valeria
・"Beginning of Summer Days" Costume Set
　"Bright Treasure" Swimsuit Costume for Rias
　"Ocean Hero" Swimsuit Costume for Slade
　"Street Aestus" Swimsuit Costume for Raze
　"Beachside Witch" Swimsuit Costume for Wilbell
　"Coral Fairy" Swimsuit Costume for Totori
　"Sunset Relaxation" Swimsuit Costume for Sophie
・Recipe Expansion Pack "The Essence of Alchemy"
・High-Difficulty Dungeon "Backwards-Ticking Clock Workshop"
・Season Pass Purchase Bonus
　"Alchemist of Memories" Costumes for Rias and Slade
　"Modified Knight's Uniform" Costume for Rias
　"Knight's Uniform" Costume for Slade

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657953/cd2e903cbe5c9cda4102edc6fd3c5d3e265a1603.jpg[/img]
